questions.question: Answer quality from a production agent has declined, but latency and error rates are normal. Which feature detects this kind of change?

options.text: Continuous evaluation of sampled live responses
options.why: Correct. Evaluators such as groundedness score answer quality over time.
Quota affects throttling, not quality.
Networking does not measure quality.
Policy enforces configuration and does not score answers.

questions.explanation: Metrics cover platform health, and evaluators cover answer quality.

questions.scenario: Groundedness scores fell after a policy update. The model version and prompt have not changed.
questions.question: What should you check first?

options.text: The Azure AI Search indexer run history
options.why: Correct. A failed or incomplete ingestion leaves stale content for retrieval.
Address ranges do not affect groundedness.
Tags do not affect answers.
This is unrelated to the policy index.

questions.explanation: Check data ingestion when quality drops after content changes.

questions.question: Where can you inspect each model call, tool call and approval for a single agent run?

options.why: Correct. Tracing records the spans of each run.
The activity log shows control-plane operations, not run details.
These record network flows, not agent steps.
Advisor gives recommendations and not run traces.

questions.question: Search queries on an Azure AI Search service are throttled during peak hours while the index size is small. What should you add?

options.why: Correct. Replicas serve queries and improve availability.
Partitions add storage and indexing capacity, not query capacity.

options.text: A second index with the same data
options.why: This does not increase query capacity of the service.
This does not address query throttling.

questions.explanation: Replicas scale query load and partitions scale storage.

questions.question: You want an alert when safety guardrails block an unusual number of requests. Which signals should you use?

options.text: Guardrail and content filter event metrics or logs with an alert rule
options.why: Correct. Safety events are monitored through metrics and logs with alerts.
These are unrelated.
Ownership has no relation to blocked requests.
The model card is documentation, not live monitoring.

questions.explanation: Monitor safety events like any other operational signal.
